title: The Dinosaur Asteroid Made a Tsunami Up to 30,000x Stronger Than 2004's

scenes.text: The dinosaur asteroid caused a tsunami like nothing in history.
Scientists modeled it at up to thirty thousand times the energy of the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami.
The asteroid was about nine miles wide, moving twenty-seven thousand miles an hour.
Near the crater, waves rose higher than three hundred feet.
Within two days, big waves reached most coastlines on Earth.
Rock layers at over a hundred sites around the world match the model.

description:
The dinosaur asteroid caused a tsunami like nothing in history.
A 2022 study modeled waves with up to 30,000 times the energy of the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami, and rock layers at over 100 sites match it.
What would you have done on the shore that day?
first_comment: Bonus: the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami is the benchmark. This one is modeled at up to 30,000 times its energy. Could anything survive that?
